## Sizing & Code Health Checklist

- [ ] **Line-budget**: Total additions are under **+500 lines** of functional code (excluding lockfiles & compiled bundles).
- [ ] **Single concern**: This PR addresses one specific bug, feature, or cleanup — not multiple unrelated changes.
- [ ] **Tests pass**: Ran `npm test` locally and all SDK test suites pass cleanly.
- [ ] **Build verified**: Ran `npm run build` with clean types and zero bundle errors.
- [ ] **Anti-AI slop**: No generic boilerplate, no redundant comments (`// loop through items`), no unused stubs (`// TODO`).
- [ ] **Secrets & security**: No tokens, API keys, or personal credentials in code, diffs, or test fixtures.
